Measure a fibre tip against the midline

  1. Drop in your section images (any format your browser opens).
  2. Set the scale — type µm per pixel, or click two points a known distance apart.
  3. Place three marks: the fibre tip, then a dorsal and a ventral point on the midline.
  4. Type the AP level you matched the section to, if you have it.
You get ML distance from the midline (signed), depth below the dorsal surface, and height above the ventral surface — measured along your own axis, so a tilted or rotated section still reads correctly.

Scale

Type µm/px if you know it, or click two points a known distance apart (a scale bar, or a structure you have measured).

Placing

Put the dorsal and ventral marks on the midline — at the brain surface if you want depth from the surface. If the section is upside down, Flip 180° first so dorsal is at the top; the panel warns if the dorsal mark ends up below the ventral one.
